title: Twenty Years in Small Squares

pre.en: What did Tom do with one of Priya's stamps?
pre.zh: Tom 拿 Priya 的一张邮票干了什么？
options: He sold it at a car-boot sale.
He used it to post a parking fine.
He gave it to a charity shop.
He lost it under the bed.

intro: 这是一篇人物小传，写的是 Tom 的女朋友 Priya：会计，集邮二十年。读的时候留意可数和不可数：How many stamps、not many of them、a little money、a lot of time、a few car-boot sales、how much it cost——说「多少」，先看后面的名词能不能数。

sentences.en: Priya Shah is a 31-year-old accountant from Croydon, and she's been collecting stamps for twenty years.
sentences.zh: Priya Shah 今年 31 岁，是克罗伊登的一名会计，集邮已经二十年了。

sentences.en: It all started when she was eleven.
sentences.zh: 这事要从她十一岁说起。

sentences.en: That year, her grandfather handed down three old albums from Gujarat.
sentences.zh: 那年，爷爷把三本从古吉拉特带来的旧集邮册传给了她。

sentences.en: She was fascinated by them at once, and she's hung on to every single one.
sentences.zh: 她一下子就被迷住了，每一本都留到了今天。

sentences.en: So how many stamps does she have now?
sentences.zh: 那她现在有多少张邮票？

sentences.en: "About 4,000, but not many of them are valuable," she says.
sentences.zh: 「大概四千张，不过值钱的没几张，」她说。

sentences.en: The hobby costs her a little money and a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 这个爱好花不了她多少钱，却很花时间。

sentences.en: Every spring, she looks through the boxes at a few car-boot sales in Surrey.
sentences.zh: 每年春天，她都会去萨里郡的几个后备箱集市翻箱子。

sentences.en: There, a bag of old envelopes costs less than a coffee.
sentences.zh: 在那儿，一袋旧信封比一杯咖啡还便宜。

sentences.en: She's run out of shelf space, so lots of albums now live under her bed.
sentences.zh: 书架早就放不下了，所以很多集邮册现在都住在她床底下。

sentences.en: Actually, her best stamp turned up by accident.
sentences.zh: 其实，她最好的一张邮票是碰巧得来的。

sentences.en: Six years ago, a charity shop near her flat was short-staffed.
sentences.zh: 六年前，她家附近一家慈善商店人手不够。

sentences.en: A busy volunteer sold her a box of old postcards for £2.
sentences.zh: 一位忙得团团转的志愿者，2 英镑就把一盒旧明信片卖给了她。

sentences.en: On one of them was an Indian stamp from the 1960s with a printing mistake.
sentences.zh: 其中一张明信片上贴着一枚 1960 年代的印度邮票，印错了。

sentences.en: It's worth around £400.
sentences.zh: 这张值 400 英镑左右。

sentences.en: "I was so excited that I couldn't sleep," she says.
sentences.zh: 「我激动得睡不着，」她说。

sentences.en: "It kept me awake until three."
sentences.zh: 「一直到凌晨三点都没合眼。」

sentences.en: She hasn't always been so lucky, though.
sentences.zh: 不过她也不是一直这么走运。

sentences.en: At fourteen, she paid £50 for a stamp that turned out to be a fake.
sentences.zh: 十四岁那年，她花 50 英镑买了一张邮票，结果是假的。

sentences.en: Well, she learned from her mistakes.
sentences.zh: 好在她吸取了教训。

sentences.en: Now she knows the history of Indian stamps inside out.
sentences.zh: 现在她对印度邮票的历史了如指掌。

sentences.en: At her first stamp fair, she was too shy to introduce herself.
sentences.zh: 第一次去邮票展会时，她害羞得连自我介绍都不敢。

sentences.en: These days, dealers in London know her by name.
sentences.zh: 如今，伦敦的邮商都叫得出她的名字。

sentences.en: She takes pride in knowing where each stamp has been, and how much it cost to send a letter that year.
sentences.zh: 她最得意的，是知道每张邮票去过哪儿，那一年寄一封信要花多少钱。

sentences.en: Her boyfriend, Tom, pulls a face whenever she brings stamps to the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 她男朋友 Tom 一看到她把邮票带上饭桌，就一脸嫌弃。

sentences.en: And last year, he took one from her kitchen drawer to pay a parking fine by post.
sentences.zh: 去年，他还从她家厨房抽屉里拿了一张，贴在信封上寄去交停车罚款。

sentences.en: The fine was £35.
sentences.zh: 罚款是 35 英镑。

sentences.en: The stamp was worth £60.
sentences.zh: 那张邮票值 60 英镑。

cards.note: to give something to a younger person in your family
cards.tip: 常用被动：be handed down (from sb)；穿哥哥姐姐的旧衣服叫 hand-me-downs。
cards.example: This watch was handed down from my great-grandfather.

cards.note: stamp album 集邮册；也指音乐专辑。
to be extremely interested in something
cards.tip: 人「着迷」用 fascinated，让人着迷的东西用 fascinating：a fascinating book。
cards.example: As a child, I was fascinated by trains.

cards.note: to keep something and not give it away or throw it away
cards.tip: hang 表示「挂」时过去式是 hung；英式也说 hang onto。
cards.example: Hang on to your receipt in case you need to take it back.

cards.note: to look at a lot of things in a box, pile or document, usually quickly
cards.tip: through 表示从头翻到尾；look at 只是「看」一眼。
cards.example: I looked through my old photos last night.

cards.note: 英国特色：大家把旧东西放在汽车后备箱里卖。
重音在第一个音节。
to use all of something so that none is left
without planning it or wanting it to happen
cards.tip: 反义是 on purpose（故意）；和 by chance 意思接近。
cards.example: I found the café by accident when I got lost.

cards.note: 卖捐来的旧物，收入给慈善机构，店员多是志愿者。
to not have enough workers
cards.tip: 形容词，带连字符；也说 be understaffed。
cards.example: The restaurant is short-staffed on Sundays.

cards.note: 也能当动词：volunteer to help。
to stop someone from falling asleep
cards.tip: 主语可以是声音、咖啡、心事；keep 的过去式是 kept。
cards.example: The neighbours' party kept us awake all night.

cards.note: 也能当形容词：a fake stamp。
to understand what you did wrong so that you do better next time
to know everything about something
to tell someone your name when you meet them for the first time
stamp dealer 邮商，car dealer 车商。
to feel pleased about something you do or have and to do it carefully
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing；pride 前面不加 a。
cards.example: He takes pride in his cooking.

cards.zh: （因为不喜欢）皱起脸；露出嫌弃的表情
cards.note: to make an expression with your face to show that you do not like something
cards.tip: 英式说法，美式多说 make a face；冲某人做鬼脸用 at。
cards.example: My son pulled a face when he saw the vegetables.
